notes.title: ASU Global Update
notes.content:
Update

Crafting -> Equipment Exchange
Background armor exchange function has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43388269/43db84ded6fc6e54b51ef78775490f681618fd66.png[/img]
<Select the equipment to exchange>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43388269/2bfa8db111ba1ffd37769783bca7bc54efd4808c.png[/img]
<Select an item for which production materials have been completed in the list and complete production through the production button.>

If the crafting is successful, it will be exchanged for equipment suitable for your job.
H-class weapon -> H-class weapon of the current job
H-class helmet -> H-class helmet of the current job
H-class armor -> H-class armor of the current job
H-class gloves -> H-class gloves of the current job
H-class shoes -> H-class shoes of your current job

Attributes are randomly assigned to completed H-grade equipment.

tags.feature: Background armor exchange function has been added.

notes.title: ASU Global Update
notes.content:
Updates
1. Addition of safe zone maintenance time for Territory War
    -> If you do not leave the safe zone for 100 seconds during the game of Yeongji, you will be forcibly moved to the village.
2. Addition of re-entry time to Yeongjijeon
    ->If you leave the arena through the exit function within the territory, you cannot re-enter for 150 seconds.
3. Add Xerath, Territory Guardian
    -> Central Tower Territory Guardian Xerath has been added.
4. Side tower regeneration function added
    ->If the side tower is destroyed, it will be recreated with a certain probability after 3 minutes.

notes.title: ASU Global Update
notes.content:
February 03, 2023
New content "Territory War" will be updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43388269/1ce9dee928ff3ea1dacf63909eb4b8e2b73293f8.png[/img]

"Territory War" is held from Monday to Friday from 20:00 to 20:30.

Join Time : 18:00~19:50
Battle Ready Time : 19:00~20:00
Battle Time : 20:00~20:30

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43388269/af4c3176570676a70f5bebaf83461af9d10e7eff.png[/img]
When it is time for Territory War, the Torritory War button will be displayed on the screen, and you can apply for participation through the Torritory War button.

Level : 40Lv
Cost Gold : 150,000 Gold
Customers who have applied for participation within the application time can enter "Territory War" from 19:50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43388269/2c6aa0cf99cdd0651de5ebc89dd751bc2b331acd.png[/img]
Participants will be divided into Red Team and Blue Team to proceed with the battle, and you can party with the same team.
The team that scores the most points within the battle time wins.

Points for destroying a tower in "Territory War"
1. Tower 200 point
2. Tower 300 point
3. Tower 200 point

10 points for user PK of the opposing team

When the battle time is over, victory rewards will be given to the participants in the Territory Battle of the winning team, and ranking rewards will be sent to the top 7 individual players by mail.

Server check for update
02/03/2023 13:00~16:00(UTC+9)
